classification.difficultyReason: Identify the enclosing and removed shapes, convert supplied diameters to radii, and subtract their areas. The semicircle with a triangular opening requires using the marked perpendicular triangle height rather than its sloping sides.

content.prompt: Calculate the areas of these composite shapes using subtraction. Round your answers to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Rectangle with a quadrant removed from its upper-left corner; dashed edges preserve the removed corner.
spec.mathematics: The full rectangle measures 20 mm by 9 mm. The removed quadrant has radius 9 mm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; the supplied area is retained in the answer.

spec.description: Square enclosing a circle touching all four sides; the four corner regions are shaded.
spec.mathematics: Square side and circle diameter are 24 km; circle radius is 12 km.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 24 km dimension is visible.

spec.description: Concentric circles with a centre dot, an upper-left inner radius and a downward complete outer radius.
spec.mathematics: Inner radius 4 cm; outer radius 7 cm. The 7 cm measurement is not the ring thickness.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the two supplied radius measurements are visible.

spec.description: Concentric circles with a centre dot, dashed inner radius to the right, and external vertical outer-diameter dimension.
spec.mathematics: Inner radius 3 m; outer diameter 10 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source radius and diameter are visible.

spec.description: Concentric circles with a horizontal inner-diameter dimension and external vertical outer-diameter dimension.
spec.mathematics: Inner diameter 9 cm; outer diameter 15 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied diameter measurements are visible.

spec.description: Upper semi-annulus, with the opening diameter labelled on the baseline and a separate complete-width dimension below.
spec.mathematics: Inner diameter 6 cm; outer diameter 10 cm.

spec.description: Downward-pointing triangle with its lower vertex right of the base midpoint, a circular opening, centre dot, dashed upward radius and curved leader.
spec.mathematics: Triangle base 14 mm and perpendicular height 8 mm; circular opening radius 3.2 mm. Schematic coordinates preserve the source appearance rather than imposing unmarked tangency as an assessed condition.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given dimensions and source construction marks are visible.

spec.description: Upper semicircle with an inscribed triangle removed, a right-angle mark at the upper vertex, dashed perpendicular altitude and diameter midpoint dot.
spec.mathematics: Semicircle diameter and triangle base 7 mm; triangle perpendicular height 3 mm. The vertex lies on the arc to the right of the centre.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given diameter, altitude and source marks are visible.
